I can do it by creating models of how dice and marbles move when a box is tilted.

I can perform an experiment that will have a different outcome if the box contains dice than if it contains marbles. Let's say I perform that experiment - the result is, "this box does not contain dice" - that doesn't mean it contains marbles. It might contain ball bearings.
